rootCause: Cumulative token spend (the rising per-record costUsd in the token_usage events) crossed the configured budget ceiling; the session terminated with endReason budget_exhausted (a resource limit, not a tool failure).
hiddenMechanism: The per-session cost rollup must be summed by hand across token_usage records today (the flight-recorder gap). No single surface reports the running total against the ceiling at the moment of the stop.
